docTitle: Build a Property Tour With Claude
source: Our own build on 17 Nov 2026: tour site written by Claude (Fable 5.2), views from one master picture made with GPT Image 2 (ChatGPT plan), 3D shots in Blender 5.2. Price range checked 17 Nov 2026 on vendor pages: realestateclubdubai.com (Dubai rendering and virtual tour prices 2026), elipsestudio.com (off-plan packages AUD 14k-60k+), framesixty.com (VR walkthroughs $20k-50k+), maverickframe.com (CGI walkthrough from about $1,500).
reference: Own WithHammad build of a fictional concept project (Halo Sky Residences); topic signal from an owner-sent post (competitor watch pick cd60314ff09e); carousel template: AI Central style

instagram.title: A tour buyers *can click through*
instagram.get: studios quote about $1,500 for a CGI walkthrough and $20,000+ for an interactive build; this one took an afternoon

instagram.title: Plan the Project
instagram.what: Claude turns one idea into views, captions, facts and a palette
instagram.prompt: Act as the marketing lead for a luxury tower called [name] in [city]. Give me 4 outside views and 3 inside views a buyer would want to see, one caption each, the 3 facts buyers ask about first, a palette with hex codes and 2 fonts every computer has. Keep it believable for [city].

instagram.title: Make One Master Picture
instagram.what: Every other view is built from this one picture, so the building never changes
instagram.prompt: Photoreal architectural render, 21:9. [Paste the building description from step 1.] Golden hour, crisp reflections on the glass, premium real-estate look. No people, no text, no logos.
instagram.meta: Any image model (we used GPT Image 2)

instagram.title: Turn It Into 7 Views
instagram.what: Attach the master picture and ask for one view at a time
instagram.prompt: Use the attached picture as the reference. Show [view: aerial / rooftop pool / living room / spa bath]. Same building, same materials, same light. Photoreal, 21:9, no people, no text.

instagram.title: Build the Tour Site
instagram.what: One HTML file you can preview right in the chat
instagram.prompt: Build a one-file HTML property tour. Full-screen view in the middle with a slow zoom, a header with [name] and a 'Book a private viewing' button, a glass 'Choose your view' panel with Outside and Inside tabs, and the view name plus 3 facts bottom left. Use my palette. It must work on a phone.

instagram.title: Make It Feel Alive
instagram.what: Small motion is what keeps buyers clicking
instagram.bestFor: Turning a page into a product
instagram.prompt: Fade between views in 0.4 seconds, highlight the active row, let the arrow keys move to the next view, add a pulsing 'Live tour' label, and move the panel to the bottom on phones. Change nothing else.

instagram.title: Add Moving Shots
instagram.what: Optional: swap the stills for short clips from any video model
instagram.bestFor: When the client pays for video
instagram.prompt: Here are my .mp4 links in the same order as the views: [links]. Play each one muted, looped, with no controls, filling the frame. Show the still picture while a clip loads, and fall back to it if a link fails.

instagram.title: Pitch a Developer
instagram.what: The tour is your sample; the DM sells the real one
instagram.prompt: Write a DM under 60 words to the sales director at [developer], who is selling [project] in [city]. Link: [my tour]. Lead with what buyers see before anything is built. Offer a tour of their project for [price] in 7 days. Then write my reply if they say it's too expensive.

instagram.sub: Label every render as a concept.
bullets: Pick a building in your city
Send the link to one developer
